title: The Venue CU

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: The Venue CU houses two distinct spaces that can be configured to fit the scale and tone of any corporate gathering. The Varsity Ballroom seats up to 250 guests for formal dinner-style events and accommodates up to 400 in an auditorium or theater-style layout, making it ideal for large presentations, award ceremonies, and company-wide galas. Its 1906 tin ceilings and updated vintage brick create an atmosphere that is professional without feeling sterile. For smaller executive meetings, breakout sessions, or cocktail receptions, the Main Street Lounge holds up to 100 guests and features a beautifully restored 1930s soapstone bar that sets the tone from the moment guests arrive. services.name: View Ballroom
services.desc: Varsity Ballroom is the centerpiece event space at The Venue CU in downtown Champaign, Illinois. Featuring original 1906 tin ceilings, vintage brick, and a professional Pro Audio sound system, the ballroom seats up to 250 for dinner and scales to 400 in auditorium configuration. It is available for weddings, corporate events, nonprofit galas, and large private celebrations. Varsity Ballroom sits inside a building that has been a cornerstone of downtown Champaign since the late 1800s. The space earned its character the old-fashioned way: through meticulous restoration work carried out in collaboration with state and federal historians.
